spec.bug: The previous cycle drops while a turn is open, so a resize mid-turn loses the turn's start.
spec.find:
/\ ~open
    /\ (~Saved \/ st >= cf)
spec.replace: /\ (~Saved \/ st >= cf)

spec.bug: A block leaves memory before the log holds it.
spec.find: /\ (~Saved \/ st >= cf)
spec.replace: /\ TRUE

spec.bug: The previous cycle is never dropped, so memory grows with every compaction.
spec.find:
CanDrop(po, cf, open, st) ==
    /\ po # None
spec.replace:
CanDrop(po, cf, open, st) ==
    /\ FALSE /\ po # None

spec.bug: The same bug, seen by the liveness property.
spec.find:
CanDrop(po, cf, open, st) ==
    /\ po # None
spec.replace:

spec.bug: A resize reprints every held block in one slice and freezes the loop.
spec.find:
to |-> Min(paintedThrough + Slice, nextSeq)]>>
               /\ paintedThrough' = Min(paintedThrough + Slice, nextSeq)
spec.replace:
to |-> nextSeq]>>
               /\ paintedThrough' = nextSeq

spec.bug: A block finished during a reprint is painted at once, and the reprint skips the blocks before it.
spec.find:
/\ IF reprinting
          THEN /\ out' = <<>> /\ UNCHANGED paintedThrough
spec.replace:
/\ IF FALSE
          THEN /\ out' = <<>> /\ UNCHANGED paintedThrough

spec.bug: Each reprint slice repeats the last block of the one before.
spec.find: ELSE /\ out' = <<[kind |-> "reprint_slice", from |-> paintedThrough,
spec.replace: ELSE /\ out' = <<[kind |-> "reprint_slice", from |-> IF paintedThrough > HeldFirst THEN paintedThrough - 1 ELSE paintedThrough,

spec.bug: The reprint reaches the newest block and keeps going.
spec.find: THEN /\ reprinting' = FALSE /\ out' = <<[kind |-> "repaint_live"]>>
spec.replace: THEN /\ reprinting' = TRUE /\ out' = <<[kind |-> "repaint_live"]>>

spec.bug: A change to one live block starts a full reprint: the whole-transcript cost per update.
spec.find: /\ UNCHANGED <<core, alive, cycleStarts>>
spec.replace:
/\ reprinting' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cycle, cycleFirst, prevFirst, nextSeq, savedThrough, live, turnOpen, paintedThrough, coOpen, coLo, coHi, coAtStart, pending, pendingDir, nextToken, alive, cycleStarts>>

spec.bug: Opening Ctrl+O reads the log instead of showing the newest blocks from memory.
spec.find:
/\ out' = <<[kind |-> "ctrlo_show",
                 lo |-> Max(HeldFirst, IF nextSeq > Window THEN nextSeq - Window ELSE 0),
                 hi |-> nextSeq]>>
spec.replace: /\ out' = <<[kind |-> "read_log", token |-> nextToken, dir |-> "older", from |-> nextSeq, count |-> Step]>>

spec.bug: Reading older blocks keeps the newest ones, so Ctrl+O's window grows without bound.
spec.find: hi2 == IF pendingDir = "older" THEN Min(coHi, coLo - n + Window) ELSE coHi + n
spec.replace: hi2 == IF pendingDir = "older" THEN coHi ELSE coHi + n

spec.bug: A reply to an earlier read moves the window as if it answered the pending one.
spec.find:
/\ IF coOpen /\ pending = token
          THEN LET n ==
spec.replace:
/\ IF coOpen /\ pending # 0
          THEN LET n ==

spec.bug: Closing Ctrl+O leaves its read in flight.
spec.find: /\ coOpen' = FALSE /\ pending' = 0 /\ out' = <<>>
spec.replace: /\ coOpen' = FALSE /\ UNCHANGED pending /\ out' = <<>>

spec.bug: A --no-save session asks a log it does not have for older blocks.
spec.find:
ELSE /\ coAtStart' = TRUE
                    /\ out' = <<>>
spec.replace:
ELSE /\ coAtStart' = TRUE
                    /\ out' = <<[kind |-> "read_log", token |-> nextToken, dir |-> "older", from |-> coLo, count |-> Step]>>

spec.bug: Resume holds blocks the log never received.
spec.find: /\ nextSeq' = savedThrough /\ cycleFirst' = last
spec.replace: /\ nextSeq' = nextSeq /\ cycleFirst' = last

spec.bug: The reader takes every reply as empty and never moves past memory.
spec.find: THEN LET n == Min(Min(count, Step), Available(pendingDir))
spec.replace: THEN LET n == 0

spec.bug: A drop frees blocks of the current cycle, which is still on screen and may be reprinted.
spec.find: DropEffect(from, to) == IF from < to THEN <<[kind |-> "drop", from |-> from, to |-> to]>> ELSE <<>>
spec.replace: DropEffect(from, to) == IF from < to THEN <<[kind |-> "drop", from |-> from, to |-> nextSeq]>> ELSE <<>>

spec.bug: A finished block is painted under the next block's number.
spec.find: ELSE /\ out' = <<[kind |-> "paint_final", seq |-> nextSeq]>>
spec.replace: ELSE /\ out' = <<[kind |-> "paint_final", seq |-> nextSeq + 1]>>

spec.bug: A resize reprints from the start of the session, below the held blocks.
spec.find: /\ reprinting' = TRUE /\ paintedThrough' = HeldFirst
spec.replace: /\ reprinting' = TRUE /\ paintedThrough' = 0

spec.bug: A reply brings as many blocks as it claims, not at most one read step.
spec.find: THEN LET n == Min(Min(count, Step), Available(pendingDir))
spec.replace: THEN LET n == Min(count, Available(pendingDir))

core.replace: if (!co.open or co.pending == 0 or (co.pending != token and false)) return reject(state, .stale_reply);

core.bug: Ctrl+O opens on blocks memory no longer holds.
A garbage reply count is trusted.
Resume keeps the dead process's Ctrl+O and live blocks.
An unsaved session reads the log when scrolling newer through dropped blocks.
An empty older reply does not mark the start of the log.
A compaction marks every earlier block saved.
